rounds.title: Active Ageing Card top-up
rounds.english: Active Ageing Card holders will receive a $50 top-up in December. Check your Active Ageing Card balance online, or visit a community centre for help with your Active Ageing Card.
rounds.explanation: The approved term was used twice, then a different wording slipped in. Residents may think it is a different card.

rounds.title: Community Garden Grant
rounds.english: Applications for the Community Garden Grant open on 1 March. Each estate may receive one Community Garden Grant per year. Submit your Community Garden Grant proposal through your town council.
rounds.explanation: One sentence used a different name for the same grant. Consistent terms help residents find the right scheme.

rounds.title: Digital Skills Voucher
rounds.english: Residents aged 50 and above can claim a Digital Skills Voucher. Use the Digital Skills Voucher at any partner library. The Digital Skills Voucher is valid until 31 December.
rounds.explanation: The last sentence switched to a different term. A glossary keeps scheme names consistent across a notice.

rounds.title: Neighbourhood Health Screening
rounds.english: Neighbourhood Health Screening returns this Saturday. Bring your appointment slip to the Neighbourhood Health Screening counter. Neighbourhood Health Screening is free for residents.
rounds.explanation: The counter used a different name from the event. Small inconsistencies like this confuse readers.
